title: Residuated mappings and homomorphisms in posets
summary: The concept of weakly regular residuated mappings was investigated for lattices recently by S. Radeleczki and L. Veres. We modify this concept for posets. We define so-called operator-residuated mappings in posets, show their important properties and point out differences between them and residuated mappings defined in the usual way. We modify the concept of a lattice homomorphism for posets where suprema need not exist and show its relation to residuated mappings and induced ideals.
